# Naviamp v2.10.0

Naviamp is now available from the Microsoft Store on Windows. Version 2.10.0 completes certificate-protected server connections across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux. It also brings your playlists to artist pages, makes smart playlists safer and easier to build, gives Radio clearer controls, and fixes Android playback recovery crashes.

## Highlights

- Install Naviamp for Windows from its official Microsoft Store listing.
- Import client certificates and private server authorities, then browse and play uncached music through the authenticated connection on every platform.
- Find your playlists on artist pages, reorder smart-playlist rules and sort priorities, and use clearer Radio controls with more reliable playback recovery.

## Features

- Install Naviamp for Windows through the [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9pcfj644lxll?hl=en-US&gl=US), alongside existing direct downloads. ([Issue #323](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/323), [PR #324](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/324), [Issue #340](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/340), [PR #341](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/341))
- Connect to certificate-protected servers on every platform: import password-protected PKCS12 client identities and private server authorities into app storage for browsing, artwork and uncached playback, including seeking on range-capable streams. ([Issue #294](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/294), [PR #296](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/296), [Issue #297](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/297), [PR #298](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/298))
- Find playlists you created that contain an artist directly on the artist page, with an optional section controlled in Experience settings. ([Issue #302](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/302), [PR #303](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/303))

## Improvements

- Move smart-playlist filters, groups and sort priorities up or down without rebuilding their values; movement stays within the current logical group and retains keyboard focus. ([Issue #212](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/212), [PR #345](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/345))
- Select regular and smart playlist references by name, with search, duplicate-name context, preserved IDs and self-reference protection. ([Issue #211](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/211), [PR #281](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/281))
- Read summaries of ALL/ANY rules, exclusions, named playlist references, values, sort priority and limits without JSON syntax. Understand owner-specific rules and local preview coverage, with library options and JSON tools available in simpler collapsible sections. ([Issue #214](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/214), [PR #282](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/282), [Issue #299](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/299), [PR #300](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/300))
- Preview example matches from the full synced library, sync directly from the builder, and choose calendar dates with format guidance. Samples are explicitly separate from the final server ordering. ([Issue #261](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/261), [Issue #263](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/263), [Issue #267](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/267), [PR #270](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/270))
- Choose Radio and Sonic similarity explicitly, configure their initial batch sizes independently, and keep regular Radio supplied with new tracks. Similarity diagnostics help explain server failures and empty results. ([Issue #253](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/253), [PR #254](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/254), [Issue #255](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/255), [PR #256](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/256), [Issue #273](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/273), [PR #274](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/274))
- Find playlist actions first in track menus, with controls that respect smart-playlist membership. ([Issue #244](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/244), [PR #245](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/245))
- Recognize connected services by their official icons and see clearer connection labels and updated German wording. ([Issue #271](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/271), [PR #272](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/272), [Issue #275](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/275), [PR #276](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/276), [Issue #277](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/277), [PR #278](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/278), [PR #252](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/252))

- Show or hide Top Tracks on artist pages and choose a maximum of 5–50 tracks in steps of five. The default remains 10 tracks. Choose separate List/Grid layouts for playlists and Appears on albums; appearance tracks stay in a list. ([Issue #308](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/308), [PR #309](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/309), [Issue #312](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/312), [PR #313](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/313))

## Bug fixes

- Keep Sonic and other server capabilities available immediately after refreshing a Navidrome native login. ([Issue #331](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/331), [PR #334](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/334))
- Ignore late callbacks from a completed playback request so they cannot cancel pending Autoplay or process completion twice. ([Issue #333](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/333), [PR #335](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/335))
- Keep playback paused when seeking, even if a late native state callback arrives. ([Issue #346](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/346))
- Keep the main Windows window visible when opening menus and remove black tooltip padding while preserving hardware rendering for the main surface. ([Issue #325](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/325), [PR #326](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/326))
- Preserve secure credentials on first launch of the Windows Store package and retain compatibility with existing saved connections. ([Issue #337](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/337), [PR #338](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/338))
- Navigate out of TV Radio sliders with Up/Down, adjust values with Left/Right, and read the complete shared release changelog in TV About. ([Issue #332](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/332), [PR #336](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/336))
- Prevent Android playback recovery from crashing when foreground-service startup races with a stopped track or is rejected in the background. Accepted starts are acknowledged promptly; rejected starts wait for the app to become visible again. ([Issue #243](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/243), [PR #279](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/279))
- Prevent incomplete smart-playlist rules from disappearing on save, preserve sort, unlimited/percentage limits and decimal semantics, and keep unsupported definitions inspectable without destructive editing. ([Issue #205](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/205), [Issue #206](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/206), [Issue #207](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/207), [PR #270](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/270))
- Keep Library search controls stationary and preserve server matches for accented names, aliases and metadata across Artists, Albums and Songs without refreshing the library. Clearing a search restores the previous browse list. ([Issue #304](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/304), [PR #305](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/305), [Issue #306](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/306), [PR #307](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/307))
- Keep owned desktop popups behind other apps when Naviamp loses activation, and make text-entry cursors easier to see. ([Issue #246](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/246), [PR #247](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/247), [Issue #269](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/269), [PR #270](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/270))

## Upgrade notes

- No special upgrade steps are required. No database schema migration is introduced in this release.
- Certificate-protected connections require the appropriate server authority and/or client identity to be imported on each device; the client identity password is required when the PKCS12 file is protected. These private files are device-local. ([Issue #297](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/297), [PR #298](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/298))
- Radio method selection is explicit; choose another method if Sonic fails. Sonic similarity still requires support from your server and its configured services or plugins. ([Issue #273](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/273), [PR #274](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/274))

## Known issues

- The reported Android TV queue-end Autoplay stop remains under investigation; the completed-request callback fix does not establish that its original cause is resolved. ([Issue #333](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/333))
- Authenticated streams from servers without finite byte-range support or provider time offsets retain buffered-seeking limitations. ([PR #296](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/pull/296), [Verification and limits](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/blob/main/docs/verification/mtls-all-platforms-2026-10-15.md))
- Existing Google Cast limitations remain: online provider media and a reachable local network are required; physical macOS Cast verification and broader offline, lyrics and audio-effect support remain follow-ups. ([Issue #221](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/221), [Issue #223](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/223))
- Further Linux popup performance and accessibility checks remain open, including the full-app CPU budget. ([Issue #220](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/220), [Issue #203](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/203))
- Android TV and Naviamp Connect remain beta. Direct GitHub Windows and macOS downloads are not publisher-signed; the iOS IPA requires signing for sideloading. ([Signing follow-up](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/issues/128), [iOS sideloading guide](https://github.com/goosepod/naviamp/blob/main/docs/ios-sideloading.md))
